title: FROST: Find Regions Of Substitution Tolerance
description: FROST finds coldspots: stretches of a protein where missense variants are rarely pathogenic. It combines four per-residue scores (AlphaMissense, ESM1b, EVE and phyloP) in a two-state hidden Markov model trained on the BRCA1 coldspot. Code for: Benazouz et al., Scalable identification of mutationally tolerant regions in 1,336 disease-associated genes (2026).
